claims.claim: The rock at the bottom was about 180 °C, far hotter than predicted
claims.source_checked: Lobanov, Chicherov & Sharov 2021, 'The 50th Anniversary of the Start of Drilling the Kola Superdeep Well', Arktika i Sever 44:267-284, DOI 10.37482/issn2221-2698.2021.44.267 (full PDF read: http://www.arcticandnorth.ru/upload/iblock/61f/44_224_239.pdf); Zhu & Huang 2026, 'Ultradeep drilling beyond 10 km...', Commun. claims.claim: Longer wells exist, but they run sideways.
claims.source_checked: No A2 source opened. A web-search summary named Al Shaheen BD-04A (12,289 m measured length, far shallower vertical depth); the SOURCES block names Sakhalin-1 and Al Shaheen from secondary reports.
claims.note: Plausible and the right distinction (measured depth vs true vertical depth), but not sourced to A2. Settles with: an operator's primary record (Maersk Oil/Qatar for BD-04A, ExxonMobil or Rosneft for the Sakhalin-1 Chayvo/Odoptu wells) or an SPE paper giving measured depth and TVD; or cut the sentence.
